title: Safe Word
summary: A safe word is a pre-agreed word that means 'stop now', used especially in BDSM or role-play where 'no' might be part of the scene. Choose something unusual and easy to remember.
key_points: A non-verbal signal (dropping an object, tapping) is needed if speech is restricted.
Using it should never cause guilt or punishment.
answer_guidance: Define the term plainly first, in the user's language and register. Stay educational rather than erotic; if asked 'how', explain non-graphically with emphasis on mutual comfort and consent. Don't force flirting, pet names or emojis — personality comes from the runtime.
